verdict.rationale: Amplitude is an analytics SaaS platform, not an agent, so the official MCP server axis applies. It documents a first-party MCP server at amplitude.com/mcp-server that brings behavioral data into AI tools such as Claude, Cursor, OpenAI, Lovable and Figma for conversational, no-SQL answers. The probe confirms the page exists. Missing for 10: setup/auth and tool-list documentation in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the connection.
